report:
Reviewed the complete body_interfaces claim, both ordinary implementation entries, the ordinary Clone trace test, and the explicit TODO test. The requirements are the permitted own-source/own-signature and demanded interface dependency envelope; exclusion of callee and sibling bodies; and unchanged completed caller output and execution after a callee-body-only edit. LocalFnSym::body is a tracked query that reads self.sig and self.cst, imports its own parameters/return/owner environment into a fresh InferCtx, checks only its own cst.body, coerces the result, finalizes, and finishes. Its signature path reads parameter/return declarations and owner signatures, never cst.body. The added association on def_to_ty captures the essential direct-call boundary: a local function value reads local.sig, instantiates that signature and submits its parameter environment, without demanding local.body. The surrounding expression implementation consumes signatures and fields for aggregate construction/field lookup and method-resolution results for dot calls; recursive expression traversal remains within the caller source stash. This is a source-level dependency review, not a claim that all language constructs are semantically complete.

The substantive test builds DbDropGuard::db calling Clone through a derived Db, forces that single named body with an empty-diagnostic assertion, and checks the exact cold semantic metadata calls (two associated-item lists, two trait signatures, one function signature), absence of body-named metadata reads, and actual body-query execution. The second identical demand asserts both an empty metadata trace and no body-query reexecution. Captured fixture tracing records metadata operations; captured database logging records WillExecute and drains between observations, so the warm assertion measures execution rather than merely equal results. These assertions support the stated narrow cold/warm scenario; they do not by themselves prove no local sibling body executed, nor exercise a callee edit.

The separately associated todo::symbols_body_interfaces explicitly defers the full callee-body edit matrix and sibling-body traces. This is an honest, accepted testing deferral: completing it requires controlled edits retaining caller identity/signatures and assertions over caller checked-result equality and execution traces, plus cold sibling-body nonexecution cases. The empty TODO is not behavioral coverage and its passing status is not counted as verification. In particular unchanged-output and no-reexecution under callee-body edits remain deferred test obligations, not results established by the unchanged warm test. No implementation TODO/N/A entries exist. No suspected behavioral failure was identified in the reviewed paths.

Added one implementation association comment in crates/sage-ir/src/check/expr.rs, ran cargo fmt, restarted the review, and recaptured all helper dependencies. Executed cargo test -p sage-test-harness --lib clone_method_body_has_a_narrow_reusable_semantic_query_trace: 1 passed, 0 failed. Executed cargo build: passed with existing warnings. Central coordinator owns the delegated post-codegen and Sage sanity checks for this evidence-only comment change.
